summary: PO of 09.06.2021, section 8(3): 69 ECTS compulsory area (language practice plus basic and advanced modules in cultural studies, linguistics and literature, including one foundation seminar per sub-discipline under section 8(4)), 37 ECTS electives in two of three sub-disciplines (focus 1: qualification module 13 ECTS plus specialization module 11 ECTS in the same sub-discipline; focus 2: qualification module 13 ECTS), the 12-ECTS thesis module, the 40-ECTS minor, 11 ECTS compulsory additive key competencies and 11 ECTS study abroad. The choice rules require the two qualification modules and one specialization module. The same-sub-discipline pairing cannot be encoded in the choice fields and remains a condition in the specialization note.

categories.name: Qualification modules in two sub-disciplines
categories.note: Section 8(3): choose two of the three sub-disciplines and take both qualification modules (13 ECTS each, 26 ECTS). Focus 1 is the sub-discipline whose specialization module (11 ECTS) you also take; focus 2 is the remaining qualification module, for 37 ECTS in the elective area.

categories.name: Specialization module in focus 1
categories.note: Section 8(3): take the specialization module (11 ECTS) of focus 1 in the same sub-discipline as one of the two chosen qualification modules (that pair is 24 ECTS; the other qualification module is focus 2). The third sub-discipline stays outside the elective area, so its specialization module does not count for this choice.
